categories.category_name: 1. 教會一般及特殊禮儀篇

verses.text: 當稱謝進入祂的門；當讚美進入祂的院。當感謝祂，稱頌祂的名！因為耶和華本為善。祂的慈愛存到永遠；祂的信實直到萬代。
verses.application_note: 適用於主日崇拜開場宣召、讚美敬拜引言，提醒會眾帶著感恩與敬畏的心進入神的聖所。
verses.text_en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

verses.text: 神是靈，所以拜祂的必須用心靈和誠實拜祂。
verses.application_note: 適用於崇拜前心態導引，提醒會眾放下外在的形式與雜念，以真實的心靈與真理敬拜神。
verses.text_en: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

verses.text: 要將耶和華的名應得的榮耀歸給祂，以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華。
verses.application_note: 適用於崇拜宣召或敬拜帶領，引導會眾聚焦於神的聖潔與榮耀尊貴。
verses.text_en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.text: 來啊，我們要屈身敬拜，在造我們的耶和華面前跪拜。因為祂是我們的神；我們是祂草場的羊，是祂手下的民。
verses.application_note: 適用於靜心敬拜與公禱開場，建立受造者在創造主面前謙卑屈膝的敬拜心態。
verses.text_en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker. For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.text: 耶和華在祂的聖殿中；全地的人都當在祂面前肅靜，呼籲祂的名。
verses.application_note: 適用於崇拜開始前的安靜心靈引導，幫助會眾在繁雜的生活中平靜下來預備聽道。
verses.text_en: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

verses.text: 我當日傳給你們的，原是從主領受的，就是主耶穌被賣的那一夜，拿起餅來，祝謝了，就擘開，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。」飯後，也照樣拿起杯來，說：「這杯是用我的血所立的新約，你們每逢喝的時候，要如此行，為的是記念我。」
verses.application_note: 主日聖餐禮頒餅與頒杯時的最佳主禮經文，引導會眾默想基督十架受難與救贖大恩。
verses.text_en: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me. After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

verses.text: 人應當省察，然後吃這餅、喝這杯。
verses.application_note: 聖餐分發前的安靜省察提醒，引導信徒在神面前認罪、尋求和好，懷著敬虔的心領受聖餐。
verses.text_en: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

verses.text: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。
verses.application_note: 適用於聖餐禮講道，強調領受聖餐是與基督生命的深層連結及永生的盼望。
verses.text_en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day. For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

verses.text: 我們所祝福的福杯，豈不是同領基督的血嗎？我們所擘開的餅，豈不是同領基督的身體嗎？我們雖多，仍是一個餅，一個身體，因為我們都是分受這一個餅。
verses.application_note: 適用於聖餐禮中強調合一的時刻，提醒弟兄姊妹在基督裡同為一體的屬靈意義。
verses.text_en: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ? For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

verses.text: 你們每逢吃這餅，喝這杯，是宣告主的死，直等到祂來。
verses.application_note: 聖餐禮結束時的宣告經文，激勵會眾帶著宣揚福音與等待基督再臨的心志回到生活中。
verses.text_en: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.

verses.text: 所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗。凡我所吩咐你們的，都教訓他們遵守，我就常與你們同在，直到世界的末了。
verses.application_note: 洗禮典禮中宣讀的大使命經文，適用於主禮牧者宣告洗禮意義及賦予新受洗者門徒使命。
verses.text_en: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

verses.text: 所以，我們藉著洗禮歸入死，和他一同埋葬，原是叫我們一舉一動有新生的樣式，像基督藉著父的榮耀從死裏復活一樣。
verses.application_note: 適用於洗禮前的神學講解與勸勉，強調「舊事已過，獲得基督裡新生命」的屬靈象徵。
verses.text_en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

verses.text: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
verses.application_note: 適用於受洗前的信心宣告與呼召，確立信心與洗禮在救恩中的重要性。
verses.text_en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

verses.text: 你們受洗歸入基督的都是披戴基督了。並不分猶太人、希利尼人，自主的、為奴的，或男或女，因為你們在基督耶穌裏都成為一了。
verses.application_note: 適用於洗禮後頒發受洗證書或肢體接納時，宣告新受洗者在主內獲得全新身份與合一。
verses.text_en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: 這水所表明的洗禮，現在藉著耶穌基督復活，也拯救你們；這洗禮本不在乎除掉肉體的污穢，只求在神面前有清潔的良心。
verses.application_note: 適用於洗禮課堂教學，說明洗禮的核心在於心靈在神面前的立志與良心的洗淨。
verses.text_en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

verses.text: 各人要隨本心所酌定的，不要作難，不要勉強，因為捐得樂意的人是神所喜愛的。
verses.application_note: 崇拜中主日奉獻環節的讀經或講員提醒，引導會眾建立「甘心樂意」與感恩的奉獻態度。
verses.text_en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

verses.text: 所以，弟兄們，我以神的慈悲勸你們，將身體獻上，當作活祭，是聖潔的，是神所喜愛的；你們如此事奉乃是理所當然的。
verses.application_note: 適用於獻心會、立志服事或奉獻禱告，引導信徒將全人全心奉獻給神。
verses.text_en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

verses.text: 你要以財物和一切初熟的土產尊榮耶和華。這樣，你的倉房必充滿有餘；你的酒榨有新酒盈溢。
verses.application_note: 適用於主日奉獻宣召，教導信徒將最好的優先奉獻給神並經歷神的信實供應。
verses.text_en: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

verses.text: 因為你的財寶在哪裏，你的心也在那裏。
verses.application_note: 適用於奉獻相關靈修或講道，提醒信徒透過金錢管家檢視自己的屬靈優先順序。
verses.text_en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

verses.text: 少種的少收，種的多收，這話是真的。
verses.application_note: 適用於鼓勵會眾積極參與神事工的奉獻，建立「播種與收割」的屬靈定律信心。
verses.text_en: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

verses.text: 看哪，弟兄和睦同居是何等的善，何等的美！
verses.application_note: 小組開會、團契破冰或破冰禱告時的宣召，建立主內肢體相愛與合一的聚會氛圍。
verses.text_en: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.text: 你們不可停止聚會，像那是停止慣了的人，倒要彼此勸勉，既知道那日子臨近，就更當如此。
verses.application_note: 適用於勉勵弟兄姊妹穩定參與團契與小組，建立彼此守望與鼓勵的習慣。
verses.text_en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

verses.text: 因為無論在哪裏，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裏就有我在他們中間。
verses.application_note: 適用於小型小組聚會或家庭祭壇開場，宣告主耶穌同在的寶貴應許。
verses.text_en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

verses.text: 鐵磨鐵，磨出刃來；朋友相感也是如此。
verses.application_note: 適用於門徒培訓小組或同工會開場，鼓勵組員在討論中互相切磋、生命共同成長。
verses.text_en: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

verses.text: 又要彼此相顧，激發愛心，勉勵行善。
verses.application_note: 小組聚會分享時間的引導經文，鼓勵弟兄姊妹敞開心房彼此關懷與代禱。
verses.text_en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

categories.category_name: 2. 節期篇：節慶與重要節日

topics.topic_name: 降臨節與聖誕節（基督降生）

verses.text: 因有一嬰孩為我們而生；有一子賜給我們。政權必擔在他的肩頭上；他名稱為「奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君」。
verses.application_note: 適用於降臨節期默想與聖誕主日宣召，宣揚基督降生的救贖預言與神聖名號。
verses.text_en: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

verses.text: 那天使對他們說：「不要懼怕！我報給你們大喜的信息，是關乎萬民的；因今天在大衛的城裏，為你們生了救主，就是主基督。」
verses.application_note: 適用於聖誕夜報佳音、聖誕晚會或佈道會，傳達神賜給全人類平安與喜樂的好消息。
verses.text_en: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

verses.text: 必有童女懷孕生子；人要稱祂的名為以馬內利。（以馬內利翻出來就是「神與我們同在」。）
verses.application_note: 適用於降臨節燭光禮或聖誕靈修，提醒會眾基督降生的核心恩典是「神與我們同在」。
verses.text_en: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

verses.text: 道成了肉身，住在我們中間，充充滿滿地有恩典有真理。我們也見過祂的榮光，正是父獨生子的榮光。
verses.application_note: 適用於聖誕主日講道，深入說明道成肉身的神學意義與極大恩典。
verses.text_en: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

verses.text: 在至高之處榮耀歸與神！在地上平安歸與祂所喜悅的人！
verses.application_note: 聖誕詩班獻詩或崇拜結束宣告經文，將一切榮耀歸給神，並祝福會眾得享屬天平安。
verses.text_en: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

topics.topic_name: 受難週、預備節與預洗禮

verses.text: 他誠然擔當我們的憂患，背負我們的痛苦；我們卻以為他受責罰，被神擊打苦待了。哪知他為我們的過犯受害，為我們的罪孽壓傷。因他受的刑罰，我們得平安；因他受的鞭傷，我們得醫治。
verses.application_note: 受難週默想、受難夜受洗預備或受難日崇拜使用，引導會眾深深體會基督代贖的慈愛。
verses.text_en: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted. But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

verses.text: 神使那無罪的，替我們成為罪，好叫我們在他裏面成為神的義。
verses.application_note: 適用於受難節神學默想與洗禮前受洗者的生命省察，強調因信稱義的恩典。
verses.text_en: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

verses.text: 耶穌被釘在十字架上，約在申初，耶穌大聲喊著說：「以利！以利！拉馬撒巴各術尼？」就是說：「我的神！我的神！為什麼離棄我？」
verses.application_note: 受難夜默想十架七言時使用，體會基督為承擔人類罪孽所經歷與父神分離的極大痛苦。
verses.text_en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

verses.text: 耶穌嘗了那醋，就說：「成了！」便低下頭，將靈魂交付神了。
verses.application_note: 受難日紀念禮拜核心經文，宣告基督救贖大功告成，罪的贖價已完全付清。
verses.text_en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

verses.text: 因為我們作仇敵的時候，且藉著神兒子的死，得與神和好；既已和好，就更要藉著祂的生命得救了。
verses.application_note: 受難週默想經文，引導信徒感恩基督的死破除了神與人之間的隔牆。
verses.text_en: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

topics.topic_name: 復活節（基督復活與盼望）

verses.text: 天使對婦人說：「不要懼怕！我知道你們是尋找那釘十字架的耶穌。他不在這裏，照他所說的，已經復活了。你們來看安放主的地方。」
verses.application_note: 復活節清晨朝陽禮拜、復活節主日宣召使用，宣告基督勝過死亡的榮耀勝利。
verses.text_en: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified. He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

verses.text: 耶穌對他說：「復活在我，生命也在我。信我的人雖然死了，也必復活；凡活著信我的人必永遠不死。你信這話嗎？」
verses.application_note: 適用於復活節講道與福音呼召，建立會眾對永生與復活的堅定信心。
verses.text_en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

verses.text: 但基督已經從死裏復活，成為睡了之人初熟的果子。
verses.application_note: 復活節讚美敬拜或講道經文，說明基督的復活是所有信徒未來體質復活的保證。
verses.text_en: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

verses.text: 死啊！你得勝的權勢在哪裏？死啊！你的毒鉤在哪裏？死毒鉤就是罪，罪的權勢就是律法。感謝神，使我們藉著我們的主耶穌基督得勝。
verses.application_note: 復活節歡慶崇拜宣告經文，讚美基督徹底擊碎死權與罪的轄制。
verses.text_en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory? The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law. But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: 願頌讚歸與我們的主耶穌基督的父神！祂曾照自己的大憐憫，藉耶穌基督從死裏復活，重生了我們，叫我們有活潑的盼望。
verses.application_note: 適用於復活節主日讚美禱告，感謝神藉基督復活賦予我們新生命與活潑的盼望。
verses.text_en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

verses.text: 五旬節到了，門徒都聚集在一處。忽然，從天上有響聲下來，好像靈風吹過，充滿了他們所坐的屋子...他們就都被聖靈充滿，按著聖靈所賜的口才說起別國的話來。
verses.application_note: 聖靈降臨節主日閱讀與默想，紀念教會降生與聖靈大能的降臨。
verses.text_en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

verses.text: 神說：在末後的日子，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。你們的兒女要說預言；你們的少年人要見異象；老年人要做異夢。
verses.application_note: 五旬節主日講道經文，宣告聖靈無分別地澆灌在每一位屬神的兒女身上。
verses.text_en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

verses.text: 彼得說：「你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈。」
verses.application_note: 適用於五旬節呼召悔改與受洗，強調聖靈是賜給每一位悔改信徒的應許禮物。
verses.text_en: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

verses.text: 因為神的國不在乎吃喝，只在乎公義、和平，並聖靈中的喜樂。
verses.application_note: 適用於聖靈降臨節崇拜，提醒會眾追求在聖靈裏獲得真平安與喜樂。
verses.text_en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

verses.text: 聖靈和新婦都說：「來！」聽見的人也該說：「來！」口渴的人也該來；願意的，都可以白白取生命的水喝。
verses.application_note: 適用於五旬節靈命渴慕呼召，邀請全會眾一同前來領受聖靈生命的活水。
verses.text_en: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

verses.text: 要常常喜樂，不住地禱告，凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裏向你們所定的旨意。
verses.application_note: 感恩節主日講道、團契感恩分享會使用，提醒信徒在各種處境中發出感謝。
verses.text_en: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

verses.text: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶穌！不可忘記祂的一切恩惠！
verses.application_note: 適用於感恩節讚美敬拜引言，引導會眾數算過去一年神的看顧與恩典。
verses.text_en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.text: 你們要稱謝耶穌，因祂本為善；祂的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.application_note: 感恩節崇拜讚美宣召經文，引導會眾向神發出純潔與讚美敬拜的心。
verses.text_en: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.text: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的就是榮耀我；那按正路而行的，我必使他得著我的救恩。
verses.application_note: 適用於感恩節奉獻與分享，提醒會眾「感恩的心」本身就是神所喜悅的祭物。
verses.text_en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

verses.text: 感謝神，因祂有說不盡的賞賜！
verses.application_note: 感恩分享會結語金句，讚美神在我們生命中所賜下無數且難以言喻的恩典。
verses.text_en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

verses.text: 你以恩典為年歲的冠冕；你的路徑都滴下脂油。
verses.application_note: 歲末感恩禮拜、年終感恩宴或小組年終分享的主題金句，感謝神一整年的厚恩。
verses.text_en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.text: 我們不致消滅，是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛；是因祂的憐憫不致斷絕。每早晨，這都是新的；你的信實極其廣大！
verses.application_note: 適用於歲末回顧，縱使過去一年有挑戰與挫折，仍讚美神天天不間斷的信實。
verses.text_en: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

verses.text: 耶和華神是太陽，是盾牌，要賜下恩惠和榮耀。祂未嘗留下一樣好處不給那些行動正直的人。
verses.application_note: 年終聚會勉勵經文，數算神過去一年的保護與無微不至的供應。
verses.text_en: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.text: 至今耶和華都幫助我們！
verses.application_note: 歲末感謝與設立「以利內謝」紀念石的立志經文，感謝神的幫助一路相隨。
verses.text_en: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

verses.text: 這事的前因後果，神都已定妥；事情的終局強如事情的起頭。
verses.application_note: 適用於歲末安慰與鼓勵，引導會眾以平靜與盼望的心為一年劃下圓滿句點。
verses.text_en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

topics.topic_name: 新春 / 農曆新年 / 跨年禱告會

verses.text: 弟兄們，我不是以為自己已經得著了；我只有一件事，就是忘記背後，努力面前的，向著標竿直跑，要得神在基督耶穌裏從上面召我來得的獎賞。
verses.application_note: 跨年禱告會或新春開工主日勵志經文，勉勵信徒放下過去的包袱，在新的一年立志追求神。
verses.text_en: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: 願耶和華賜福給你，保護你。願耶和華使祂的臉光照你，賜恩給你。願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。
verses.application_note: 新春團拜、新年祝福禱告的最佳大祭司祝福經文，宣告神的恩典臨到全家。
verses.text_en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

verses.text: 若有人在基督裏，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。
verses.application_note: 適用於新年元旦靈修，宣告在基督裡邁入全新的年歲與屬靈生命的翻轉。
verses.text_en: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

verses.text: 從歲首到年終，耶和華——你神的眼目時常看顧你的地。
verses.application_note: 新春祝福卡或新春禱告會宣召經文，應許神在新的一年每一天都有滿滿的看顧。
verses.text_en: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

verses.text: 看哪，我要做一件新事；如今要發生，你們豈不知道嗎？我必在曠野開道路，在沙漠開江河。
verses.application_note: 適用於跨年禱告會異象宣告，鼓勵會眾期待神在新的一年帶來奇妙突破。
verses.text_en: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

topics.topic_name: 母親節（尊榮母親與婦女）

verses.text: 艷麗是虛假的，美容是虛浮的；惟敬畏耶和華的婦人必得稱讚。願她享受操作所得的；願她的工作在城門口榮耀她。
verses.application_note: 母親節主日表揚與尊榮母親時使用，肯定敬畏神的女性與母親對家庭的奉獻。
verses.text_en: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised. Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

verses.text: 母親怎樣安慰兒子，我就照樣安慰你們；你們也必在耶路撒冷得安慰。
verses.application_note: 母親節特別講道，藉由母親無微不至的愛連結到上帝對我們深刻溫柔的安慰。
verses.text_en: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

verses.text: 她的兒女起來稱她有福；她的丈夫也稱讚她，說：才德的女子很多，唯獨你超過一切！
verses.application_note: 適用於母親節贈禮、卡片書寫或兒女尊榮母親時的致詞經文。
verses.text_en: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her. Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

verses.text: 想到你心裏無偽之信，這信是先在你外祖母羅以和你母親友妮基心裏的，我深信也在你的心裏。
verses.application_note: 母親節講道經文，肯定母親在家庭中傳承信仰對下一代產生的深遠影響。
verses.text_en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

verses.text: 要孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華——你神所賜你的地上得以長久。
verses.application_note: 適用於母親節勸勉全會眾，將尊榮與孝敬母親落實於日常生活中。
verses.text_en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

topics.topic_name: 父親節（尊榮父親與家長）

verses.text: 父親怎樣憐恤他的兒女，耶和華也怎樣憐恤敬畏他的人！
verses.application_note: 父親節主日勸勉經文，讚美為家庭辛勞的父親，並連結於天父對我們的慈愛。
verses.text_en: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

verses.text: 義人的父親必大得喜樂；人生智慧的兒子，必因他歡喜。
verses.application_note: 父親節主日禮拜經文，勉勵父親活出敬虔榜樣，成為兒女生命的榮耀與喜樂。
verses.text_en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

verses.text: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，只要照著主的教訓和警戒養育他們。
verses.application_note: 父親節家庭講座經文，提醒父親在家庭中擔當屬靈頭角，以愛與真理管教兒女。
verses.text_en: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

verses.text: 義人行為純正，他的後裔是有福的！
verses.application_note: 適用於父親節表揚與祝福，肯定父親正直的生命將為子孫帶來屬天的祝福。
verses.text_en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

verses.text: 你們也知道，我們怎樣勸勉你們，安慰你們，囑咐你們各人，好像父親待自己的兒女一樣。要叫你們行事對得起那召你們進祂國、得祂榮耀的神。
verses.application_note: 父親節尊榮經文，感謝父親在兒女生命成長歷程中如導師般的引導與陪伴。
verses.text_en: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children, That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

verses.text: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕，在公義的道上必能得著。
verses.application_note: 敬老節期、松年團契聚會時使用，鼓勵長者並提醒教會晚輩尊榮敬重長輩。
verses.text_en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

verses.text: 在白髮的人面前，你要站起來；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的神。我是耶和華。
verses.application_note: 重陽節敬老主日經文，教導教會重視尊老敬老的屬靈文化與誡命。
verses.text_en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.text: 他們年老的時候仍要結果子，要滿了汁漿而常發青。
verses.application_note: 適用於長者團契聚會或祝福，勉勵年長肢體在生命晚期依然能豐盛結果子。
verses.text_en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

verses.text: 直到你們年老，我仍這樣；直到你們髮白，我仍懷 his。我已造作，也必保抱；我必懷抱，也必拯救。
verses.application_note: 探訪高齡長者或敬老禮拜使用，給予長者神一生陪伴、保抱不離不棄的應許。
verses.text_en: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.

verses.text: 強壯乃少年人的榮耀；白髮為老年人的尊榮。
verses.application_note: 敬老節慶致詞經文，宣告高齡長者所累積的智慧與生命經驗是教會寶貴的資產。
verses.text_en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

topics.topic_name: 青年節 / 畢業季與升學祝福

verses.text: 不可叫人小看你年輕，總要在言語、行為、愛心、信心、清潔上，都作信徒的榜樣。
verses.application_note: 畢業祝福禮拜、青少年度聚會使用，勉勵青年學子勇敢走入新的人生階段作主的光鹽。
verses.text_en: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

verses.text: 少年人哪，你在幼年時當歡喜。在幼年的日子，使你的心快樂，行你心所願行的，看你眼所愛看的；卻要曉得，為這一切的事，神必審問你。
verses.application_note: 青年節或畢業典禮勸勉經文，鼓勵青年享受青春，同時活出敬畏神的負責任生命。
verses.text_en: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.

verses.text: 少年人用什麼潔淨他的行為呢？是要遵行你的話！
verses.application_note: 適用於青少年門徒訓練，引導年輕人在充滿誘惑的世界中以神的話語守護清純。
verses.text_en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

verses.text: 你趁著年幼、衰敗的日子尚未來到，就是你所說『我毫無喜樂』的那些年日未曾臨近之先，當記念造你的主。
verses.application_note: 適用於青年佈道會或畢業季勸勉，鼓勵年輕人及早將生命建立在創造主身上。
verses.text_en: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

verses.text: 年輕人哪，我寫信給你們，因為你們剛強，神的話常存在你們心裏，你們也克服了那惡者。
verses.application_note: 青年節聚會激勵經文，讚美年輕世代在神的話語中擁有勝過屬靈爭戰的力量。
verses.text_en: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

categories.category_name: 3. 探訪陪談篇：關懷與陪伴

verses.text: 你們中間有生病的呢，他就該請教會的長老來；他們可以奉主的名用油抹他，為他禱告。出於信心的祈禱要救那病人，主必叫他起來；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
verses.application_note: 適用於同工前去關懷、為病患按手抹油或做醫治禱告時；可提醒病人將心思專注於神的救贖與赦免。
verses.text_en: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

verses.text: 他病重在牀，耶和華必提攜他；他在病中，你必使他鋪牀。
verses.application_note: 適用於長期臥床、重病或在病房中的特別安慰，強調上帝親自的眷顧與細心陪伴。
verses.text_en: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.text: 耶和華——我的神啊，我曾呼求你，你醫治了我。
verses.application_note: 適用於探訪病患時的宣告與同心禱告，堅固受訪者對上帝醫治大能的信心。
verses.text_en: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.text: 耶和華阿，求你醫治我，我便得醫治；拯救我，我便得救；因你是我所讚美的。
verses.application_note: 適用於病痛折磨中的切切祈求，引導病患將目光焦點從痛苦轉向主耶穌。
verses.text_en: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

verses.text: 所以，我們不喪膽。外體雖然毀壞，內心卻一天新似一天。我們這至暫至輕的苦楚，要為我們成就極重無比、永遠的榮耀。
verses.application_note: 探訪慢性病或身體機能衰退的長者使用，給予內心生命天天更新與永恆榮耀的盼望。
verses.text_en: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day. For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

topics.topic_name: 心理憂鬱、焦慮與情緒低潮

verses.text: 應當毫無憂慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。神所賜、出人意外的平安必在基督耶穌裏保守你們的心懷意念。
verses.application_note: 陪伴面臨極大壓力、焦慮或恐懼的弟兄姊妹時，引導他們將注意力從問題轉向禱告與感謝。
verses.text_en: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

verses.text: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為他顧念你們。
verses.application_note: 適用於陪伴情緒低落、心靈重負過重的肢體，鼓勵他們將心中的負擔交託給神。
verses.text_en: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

verses.text: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裡面煩躁？應當仰望神，因我還要稱讚他。他是我臉上的光榮，是我的神。
verses.application_note: 陪伴陷在憂鬱與情緒幽谷的肢體時使用，同理其心中的煩躁，並溫柔引導重新仰望神。
verses.text_en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.text: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裡來，我就使你們得安息。我心裡柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裡就必得享安息。
verses.application_note: 適用於陪談精神耗竭、失眠或生活壓力過大的肢體，引導他們在耶穌裡獲得真實安息。
verses.text_en: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

verses.text: 耶和華靠近傷心的人，拯救靈魂痛悔的人。
verses.application_note: 探訪經歷心碎、失戀或重大情緒打擊者，傳遞上帝特別靠近並體恤傷心者的屬靈事實。
verses.text_en: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.text: 我生來是赤身，出母胎也必赤身歸回；賞賜的是耶和華，收取的也是耶和華。耶和華的名是應當稱頌的。
verses.application_note: 探訪臨終聖徒或家屬時使用，引導會眾以敬畏與接納的心面對生命的終點。
verses.text_en: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

verses.text: 我聽見天上有聲音說：「你要寫下：從今以後，在主裏裡面死的人有福了！」聖靈說：「是的，他們息了自己的勞苦，做工的果效也隨著他們。」
verses.application_note: 臨終床邊關懷與安息前夕，給予病患與家屬對永生和安息的堅定盼望。
verses.text_en: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

verses.text: 我行過死蔭的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因為你與我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
verses.application_note: 陪伴臨終患者床邊禱告，陪伴他們跨越生命的幽谷，經驗大牧者無所不在的安息與保護。
verses.text_en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

verses.text: 那美好的仗我已經打過了，當跑的路我已經跑盡了，所信的道我已經守住了。從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我留存。
verses.application_note: 適用於安慰臨終的老長執或忠心服事的聖徒，肯定其一生的信心與服事。
verses.text_en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

verses.text: 我們原知道，我們這地上的帳棚若拆毀了，必得神所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。
verses.application_note: 臨終關懷時使用，將肉體的衰亡比喻為拆卸暫時的帳棚，引導會眾期待天上永恆的家園。
verses.text_en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

verses.text: 願頌讚歸與我們的主耶穌基督的父神，就是發慈悲的父，賜各樣安慰的神。我們在一切患難中，他就安慰我們，叫我們能用神所賜的安慰去安慰那遭各樣患難的人。
verses.application_note: 追思探訪、治喪期間慰問遺族時使用，強調神親自的安慰以及主內肢體的陪伴。
verses.text_en: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

verses.text: 論到睡了的人，我們不願意弟兄們不知道，恐怕你們憂傷，像那是沒有指望的人一樣。我們若信耶穌死而復活了，影子也當信那些在耶穌裏睡了的人，神也必將他與耶穌一同帶來。
verses.application_note: 適用於喪禮或入殮告別式，安慰遺族這只是暫時的分離，未來在天上終必重聚。
verses.text_en: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

verses.text: 神要擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛，因為以前的事都過去了。
verses.application_note: 適用於安慰失喪親人的家屬，帶領他們瞻望未來在新天新地中不再有苦痛的永恆應許。
verses.text_en: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

verses.text: 在耶和華眼中，看聖民之死極為寶貴。
verses.application_note: 追思禮拜或入棺禮時使用，安慰遺族其至親在世的生命與離世在神眼中都是極其珍貴的。
verses.text_en: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

verses.text: 與喜樂的人要同樂；與哀哭的人要同哭。
verses.application_note: 探訪同工自我提醒，在治喪關懷中不必強加講道，而是以靜默陪伴與傾聽表達同哀之情。
verses.text_en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

verses.text: 你要專心仰賴耶和華，不可倚靠自己的聰明，在你一切所行的事上都要認定他，他必指引你的路。
verses.application_note: 適用於輔導面臨重大人生抉擇（如移民、轉職、人生方向）的肢體，提醒專心仰望神的帶領。
verses.text_en: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

verses.text: 你的話是我腳前的燈，是我路上的光。
verses.application_note: 鼓勵尋求方向的弟兄姊妹回到聖經中，讓神的話語成為每一步的明確引導。
verses.text_en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.text: 不要效法這個世界，只要心意更新而變化，叫你們察驗何為神的善良、純全、可喜悅的旨意。
verses.application_note: 陪談面臨價值觀衝突或抉擇迷惘者，提醒先將心思從世俗風尚轉向神的心意。
verses.text_en: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

verses.text: 你或向左或向右，必聽見後邊有聲音說：「這是正路，要行在其中。」
verses.application_note: 適用於陪談深陷抉擇兩難的肢體，鼓勵他們建立安靜聆聽聖靈微小聲音的習慣。
verses.text_en: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

verses.text: 求你使我清晨得聽你慈愛的話，因我倚靠你；求你使我知道當行的路，因我的心仰望你。
verses.application_note: 引導尋求引導者每日早晨以神的話語作為禱告開端，建立每日蒙引導的靈修習慣。
verses.text_en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

verses.text: 人心籌算自己的道路；惟耶和華指引他的腳步。
verses.application_note: 陪談面臨職涯轉折、求職卡關或創業抉擇的弟兄姊妹，建立對神的供應與主權的信任。
verses.text_en: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

verses.text: 耶和華說：我知道我向你們所懷的意念是賜平安的意念，不是降災害的意念，要叫你們末後有指望。
verses.application_note: 安慰求職面試挫折、前途茫茫的青年，宣告神對其未來擁有賜平安的完美計畫。
verses.text_en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

verses.text: 你所做的事，要交託耶和華，你所籌算的，就必成立。
verses.application_note: 適用於創業、專案規劃或工作計畫啟動前的陪談禱告，教導將工作果效交託給神。
verses.text_en: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

verses.text: 你們看那天上的飛鳥，也不種，也不收，也不積蓄在倉裏，你們的天父尚且養活牠。你們不比飛鳥貴重得多嗎？
verses.application_note: 陪伴面臨失業威脅或職場經濟生計焦慮者，建立對天父無微不至供應的信心。
verses.text_en: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

verses.text: 你們要先求他的國和他的義，這些東西都要加給你們了。
verses.application_note: 適用於職涯輔導，引導弟兄姊妹在選擇工作時以神的國度與價值觀為最高優先順序。
verses.text_en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

verses.text: 你們和不信的原不相配，不要同負一軛。義和不義有什麼相交呢？光明和黑暗有什麼相通呢？
verses.application_note: 適用於青年婚姻感情諮詢，提醒在婚姻與核心價值觀上尋求主內合一的重要性。
verses.text_en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

verses.text: 房屋錢財是祖宗所遺留的；惟有賢慧的妻是耶和華所賜的。
verses.application_note: 婚前輔導或青年擇偶諮詢時使用，提醒屬靈品格遠比世俗財產條件更為寶貴。
verses.text_en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers and a prudent wife is from the LORD.

verses.text: 得著賢妻的，是得著好處，也是蒙了耶和華的恩惠。
verses.application_note: 適用於尋求婚姻伴侶者的陪談禱告，鼓勵他們以禱告尋求神所預備的另一半。
verses.text_en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.

verses.text: 耶和華神說：「那人獨居不好，我要為他造一個配偶幫助他。」
verses.application_note: 適用於感情陪談，說明婚姻的核心意義在於神所設計的彼此陪伴與團隊互補。
verses.text_en: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

verses.text: 求你將我放在心上如印記，帶在你臂上如戳記。因為愛情如死之堅強...
verses.application_note: 適用於婚前輔導或愛情問題諮詢，建立對聖潔、專一且堅貞之愛的屬靈認識。
verses.text_en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.

verses.text: 你們所遇見的試探，無非是人所能受的。神是信實的，必不叫你們受試探過於所能受的；在受試探的時候，總要給你們開一條出路，叫你們能忍受得住。
verses.application_note: 陪伴陷在罪惡誘惑、戒癮或肉體弱點中掙扎的肢體，給予神信實與出路的盼望。
verses.text_en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

verses.text: 你要逃避少年的私慾，同那清心禱告主的人追求公義、信德、仁愛、和平。
verses.application_note: 輔導陷於情慾或不良嗜好試探的青年，提醒要積極主動逃避誘惑並加入清心團契。
verses.text_en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.text: 故此，你們要順服神。務要抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
verses.application_note: 適用於屬靈爭戰陪談，說明勝過仇敵試探的關鍵在於先順服神，並奉主名勇敢抵擋。
verses.text_en: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.text: 總要儆醒禱告，免得入了試探。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。
verses.application_note: 同理會眾在罪中的軟弱與掙扎，提醒建立警醒禱告的防線以防範試探。
verses.text_en: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

verses.text: 我將你的話藏在心裡，免得我得罪你。
verses.application_note: 陪談陷入罪惡感或反覆軟弱者，鼓勵以背誦與默想神的話語作為抵擋試探的武器。
verses.text_en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

verses.text: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷；將殘的燈火，他不吹滅。
verses.application_note: 探訪信仰陷入低潮、很久沒聚會或靈命受創的肢體，傳達基督溫柔不放棄的愛。
verses.text_en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

verses.text: 所以，當回想你是從哪裏墜落的，並要悔改，行最初所行的事。
verses.application_note: 溫柔提醒靈命漸漸冷淡、失去起初愛心的弟兄姊妹，鼓勵他們重新回到主面前。
verses.text_en: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

verses.text: 主耶穌說：「迷失的羊，我必尋找；被逐的，我必領回；受傷的，我必纏裹；有病的，我必醫治。」
verses.application_note: 關懷流失羊群或離開教會的肢體，傳達大牧者耶穌主動尋找與纏裹受傷心靈的心意。
verses.text_en: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

verses.text: 我們若認自己的罪，神是信實的，是公義的，必要赦免我們的罪，洗淨我們一切的不義。
verses.application_note: 適用於輔導因犯錯而不敢回到教會的弟兄姊妹，宣告神無條件的赦免與寶血洗淨的恩典。
verses.text_en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.text: 離了我，你們就不能做什麼。
verses.application_note: 陪伴因離棄神而陷入生活混亂者，引導他們體會重新接枝於葡萄樹（基督）的重要性。
verses.text_en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

verses.text: 要穿戴神所賜的全副軍裝，就能抵擋魔鬼的詭計。因我們並不是與屬血氣的爭戰，乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這幽暗世界的，以及天空屬靈氣的惡魔爭戰。
verses.application_note: 適用於遭遇屬靈干擾、家庭或心靈面臨強烈爭戰時的守望禱告與穿戴軍裝宣告。
verses.text_en: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

verses.text: 小子們哪，你們是屬神的，並且勝了他們；因為那在你們裏面的，比那在世界上的更大。
verses.application_note: 探訪遭遇恐懼、屬靈壓制或靈界干擾者使用，宣告內住聖靈的大能遠勝世界一切黑暗勢力。
verses.text_en: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

verses.text: 弟兄勝過牠，是因羊羔的血和自己所見證的道。
verses.application_note: 屬靈爭戰關懷時使用，引導肢體宣告耶穌寶血的權柄與神的話語來擊退仇敵控告。
verses.text_en: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

verses.text: 死人要聽見神兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。因神賜給我們，不是膽怯的心，乃是剛強、仁愛、謹守的心。
verses.application_note: 陪伴深陷恐懼不安與焦慮者禱告，奉主名拒絕膽怯的靈，領受剛強與謹守的靈。
verses.text_en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

verses.text: 我們爭戰的兵器本不是屬血氣的，乃是在神面前有能力，可以攻破堅固的營壘。
verses.application_note: 適用於輔導面臨長期心思營壘（如自卑、仇恨、成癮）者，宣告靠神大能攻破營壘。
verses.text_en: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

categories.category_name: 4. 信徒的生活篇：日常處境與家庭

topics.topic_name: 婚禮、婚姻生活與夫妻之道

verses.text: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
verses.application_note: 適用於婚禮證婚、婚姻輔導，強調夫婦在基督裡建立獨立且合一的新家庭關係。
verses.text_en: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

verses.text: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，不做害羞的事，不求自己的益處，不輕易發怒，不計算人的惡，不喜歡不義，只喜歡真理；凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。愛是永不止息。
verses.application_note: 適用於婚禮致詞、夫妻營會或婚姻溝通培訓，引導夫妻以基督的愛相待。
verses.text_en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil; Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth; Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things. Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

verses.text: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，如同順服主...你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，正如基督愛教會，為教會捨己。
verses.application_note: 適用於婚姻輔導與家庭座談，指導夫妻在家庭中發揮神所設立的角色與捨己責任。
verses.text_en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

verses.text: 婚姻，人人都當尊重，床也不可污穢；因為苟合行淫的人，神必要審判。
verses.application_note: 適用於婚前輔導或婚姻倫理講座，強調婚姻的神聖性與對盟約的忠貞。
verses.text_en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

verses.text: 三股合成的繩子不容易折斷。
verses.application_note: 適用於婚禮祝福與夫妻溝通輔導，提醒將基督邀請進入婚姻，成為三股合成的堅固繩索。
verses.text_en: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

verses.text_en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

verses.text: 我們愛，因為神先愛我們。
verses.application_note: 適用於靈修與愛心事工動員，建立「愛的力量源自體驗神的愛」的屬靈認知。
verses.text_en: We love him, because he first loved us.

verses.text: 你們要靠主常常喜樂。我再說，你們要喜樂。
verses.application_note: 適用於陪伴處於環境低潮或患難中的肢體，引導他們將喜樂建立於「在主裡面」而非外在環境。
verses.text_en: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

verses.text: 使人和睦的人有福了！因為他們必稱為神的兒子。
verses.application_note: 適用於人際衝突調解、肢體溝通輔導，激勵弟兄姊妹主動成為和平的締造者。
verses.text_en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

verses.text: 喜樂的心乃是良藥；憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。
verses.application_note: 探訪生病、焦慮或情緒低落肢體使用，鼓勵靠主保持喜樂的心作為屬靈的醫治良藥。
verses.text_en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

verses.text: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裏不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。
verses.application_note: 適用於陪伴面對未知恐懼、變局或不安者，領受基督所賜超越世俗的真實平安。
verses.text_en: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

verses.text: 願賜平安的神常與你們眾人同在。阿們！
verses.application_note: 適用於聚會結束祝福或小組代禱，宣告賜平安的神常與弟兄姊妹同在。
verses.text_en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

verses.text: 弟兄們哪，你們要忍耐，直到主來。看哪，農夫等候地裏寶貴的出產，心裏忍耐，直到得了秋雨春雨。
verses.application_note: 適用於祈禱未獲回應、服事果效未顯或面對苦難時的忍耐等候勸勉。
verses.text_en: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

verses.text: 我們行善，不可喪志；若不灰心，到了時候就要收成。
verses.application_note: 適用於勉勵長期服事感到疲憊的同工，建立「不灰心必有收成」的信心與盼望。
verses.text_en: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.text: 你們要以恩慈相待，存憐憫的心，彼此饒恕，正如神在基督裏饒恕了你們一樣。
verses.application_note: 適用於團契肢體關係修復，提醒以恩慈與憐憫的心彼此寬容與饒恕。
verses.text_en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

verses.text: 你不可為惡所勝，反要以善勝惡。
verses.application_note: 適用於職場或人際遭遇不公、傷害時的品格指引，堅持以屬神的良善回應惡意。
verses.text_en: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.text: 主對我說：「我的恩典夠你用的，因為我的能力是在人的軟弱上顯得完全。」
verses.application_note: 陪伴在困境中忍耐受苦的肢體，體會並靠著神夠用的恩典渡過難關。
verses.text_en: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

verses.text: 不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士；治服己心的，強如取城。
verses.application_note: 適用於情緒管理、自我約束與面對肉體慾望試探時的靈修提醒。
verses.text_en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

verses.text: 溫柔的人有福了！因為他們必承受地土。
verses.application_note: 適用於門徒八福培訓，教導信徒操練溫柔柔和的性格以承接神的屬靈應許。
verses.text_en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

verses.text: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言語暴戾，動騰怒氣。
verses.application_note: 適用於人際溝通、家庭溝通與情緒管理輔導，鼓勵用溫柔的言語化解衝突。
verses.text_en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

verses.text: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不義，在大事上也不義。
verses.application_note: 適用於服事同工訓練，強調屬靈品格中的信實與在小事上忠心的重要性。
verses.text_en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

verses.text: 凡較力爭勝的，諸事都有節制，他們不過是要得會壞的冠冕；我們卻是要得不會壞的冠冕。
verses.application_note: 適用於生活作息、成癮預防與靈修生活操練，勉勵為了永恆冠冕而操練自我節制。
verses.text_en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

verses.text: 凡事不可自私自利，不可貪圖虛榮；只要謙卑，各人看別人比自己強。各人不要單顧自己的事，也要顧別人的事。你們當以基督耶穌的心為心。
verses.application_note: 適用於教會同工團隊建立、長執培育，提醒會眾摒除私心、效法基督的僕人姿態。
verses.text_en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others. Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

verses.text: 神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
verses.application_note: 適用於同工靈修警惕，提醒警惕驕傲的心，主動在神與人面前保持謙卑。
verses.text_en: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

verses.text: 因為連人子來，並不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命作多人的贖價。
verses.application_note: 適用於服事團隊訓練，確立以基督「僕人式服事」作為事工的最高心志。
verses.text_en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.text: 你們中間誰為大，誰就要作你們的用人。凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
verses.application_note: 適用於領袖培訓，顛覆世俗權力觀念，建立「以服事他人為尊榮」的屬靈領袖觀。
verses.text_en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant. And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

verses.text: 所以，你們要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了時候，祂必叫你們升高。
verses.application_note: 適用於在處境低潮或服事挫折中的肢體，引導他們安心屈服於神的權柄與時間。
verses.text_en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

verses.text: 那召你們的既是聖潔，你們在一切所行的事上也要聖潔。因為經上記著說：「你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。」
verses.application_note: 適用於信徒世俗生活倫理警惕，提醒在職場、道德與言語上活出屬神的聖潔標準。
verses.text_en: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation; Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

verses.text: 你們的話，是的，就說是；不是，就說不是；若再多說，就是出於那惡者。
verses.application_note: 適用於日常言語品格與誠實操練，提醒說話真實、不誇大、不弄虛作假。
verses.text_en: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

verses.text: 神的旨意就是要你們成為聖潔，遠避淫行；要你們各人曉得怎樣用聖潔、尊貴守著自己的身體。
verses.application_note: 適用於青年男女身體聖潔與婚姻倫理教導，守護身心靈不妥協於世俗誘惑。
verses.text_en: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

verses.text: 行事純全的，指指點點必蒙保護；行路彎曲的，必被敗露。
verses.application_note: 職場與生活誠實專題，說明堅持光明磊落與純全正直將獲得神的保護。
verses.text_en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

verses.text: 神啊，求你為我造清潔的心，使我裏面重新有正直的靈。
verses.application_note: 適用於認罪悔改靈修禱告，求神動工洗淨內心，恢復潔淨與正直的生命狀態。
verses.text_en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.text: 並要以恩慈相待，存憐憫的心，彼此饒恕，正如神在基督裏饒恕了你們一樣。
verses.application_note: 適用於家庭關係修復、肢體傷害陪伴，引導受傷者經驗並給予源自基督的饒恕。
verses.text_en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

verses.text: 你們站著禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。
verses.application_note: 適用於禱告生活操練，提醒清除心中的怨恨與不饒恕，使禱告蒙神垂聽。
verses.text_en: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

verses.text: 彼得進前來，對耶穌說：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我當饒恕他幾次呢？到七次夠嗎？」耶穌說：「我對你說，不是到七次，乃是到七十個七次。」
verses.application_note: 適用於人際關係深度輔導，教導饒恕不是一次性的行為，而是無限度的屬靈選擇。
verses.text_en: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times? Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

verses.text: 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此包容，彼此饒恕；主怎樣饒恕了你們，你們也要怎樣饒恕人。
verses.application_note: 團契與小組生活相處原則，鼓勵弟兄姊妹主動跨越嫌隙，實踐包容與饒恕。
verses.text_en: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

verses.text: 當下耶穌說：「父啊！赦免他們；因為他們所做的，他們不曉得。」
verses.application_note: 默想十架七言，體會基督在極大苦難與不公中依然發出饒恕的極致榜樣。
verses.text_en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

verses.text: 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常謝父神。
verses.application_note: 適用於日常生活靈修，建立不論順境逆境皆能察覺神恩典的凡事感恩心態。
verses.text_en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.text: 撒母耳說：「耶和華喜悅燔祭和平安祭，豈如喜悅人聽從祂的話呢？聽命勝於獻祭；順從勝於公羊的脂油。」
verses.application_note: 適用於門徒造就與服事培訓，強調外在的形式服事無法取代內心對神話語的真實順服。
verses.text_en: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

verses.text: 你們要順服神。務要抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
verses.application_note: 適用於屬靈品格建立，說明順服神是得著屬靈權柄與勝過仇敵試探的基礎。
verses.text_en: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.text: 耶穌說：「父啊！你若願意，就把這杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。」
verses.application_note: 適用於面對人生艱難抉擇或苦難時，效法耶穌客西馬尼園順服天父旨意的祈禱。
verses.text_en: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

verses.text: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌彼此對說，口唱心和地讚美主。凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常謝父神。
verses.application_note: 小組與個人靈修操練，將讚美與感謝化為日常生活常態。
verses.text_en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.text: 你們親近神，神就必親近你們。
verses.application_note: 適用於個人靈修操練、禱告會宣召，勉勵弟兄姊妹主動尋求神面以經歷神同在。
verses.text_en: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

verses.text: 靠著聖靈，隨時多方禱告祈求；並要在此儆醒不倦，為眾聖徒祈求。
verses.application_note: 適用於禱告會訓練與代禱者培育，鼓勵在聖靈裏建立持續不間斷的祈禱習慣。
verses.text_en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

verses.text: 你們求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
verses.application_note: 適用於鼓勵信心禱告，堅信神必垂聽並回應屬神兒女切實的祈求。
verses.text_en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

verses.text: 主耶穌說：「你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，禱告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。」
verses.application_note: 適用於個人暗中靈修親近神，避免形式化，建立與天父私密深厚的關係。
verses.text_en: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

verses.text: 況且，我們的軟弱有聖靈幫助；我們本不知道當怎樣禱告，只是聖靈親自用指不出來的嘆息替我們祈求。
verses.application_note: 陪伴在極度痛苦或困惑中不知如何禱告的肢體，安慰聖靈正在親自為其代求。
verses.text_en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

verses.text: 聖經都是神所吹氣的，對於教訓、督責、矯正、在義中的訓練，都是有益的，叫屬神的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
verses.application_note: 適用於讀經運動動員、門徒造就班，強調神的話語對生命整全與全人訓練的力量。
verses.text_en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

verses.text: 惟喜愛耶和華的律法，晝夜思想，這人便為有福！他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁，按時候結果子，葉子也不枯乾。凡他所做的盡都順利。
verses.application_note: 推動天天讀經與默想，宣告神的話語能使靈命如溪水旁的樹常青且多結果子。
verses.text_en: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

verses.text: 神的道是活潑的，是有功效的，比一切兩刃的劍更快，甚至魂與靈，骨節與骨髓，都能刺入、剖開，連心中的思念和主意都能辨明。
verses.application_note: 適用於研經與靈修分享，說明神的話語具有透視與穿透心靈剖開問題的震撼大能。
verses.text_en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

verses.text: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心；耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。
verses.application_note: 讀經講座經文，強調神的話語能帶來心靈甦醒與屬天不俗的智慧。
verses.text_en: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.text: 只是你們要行道，不要單單聽道，自己欺哄自己。
verses.application_note: 主日聽道或小組查經總結經文，勉勵將所學習的神的話語實踐於每日行動中。
verses.text_en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

verses.text: 你們要休息，要知道我是神！
verses.application_note: 適用於默想營會、個人靈修或面對混亂焦慮時，引導心靈在神面前停歇安息。
verses.text_en: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.text: 但你是聖潔的，是用以色列的讚美為寶座的。
verses.application_note: 適用於讚美敬拜訓練，建立「神的同在與寶座顯現在屬神兒女真心讚美中」的認知。
verses.text_en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

verses.text: 我的心平穩安靜，好像斷過奶的孩子在他母親的懷中；我的心在我裏面真像斷過奶的孩子一樣。
verses.application_note: 適用於安靜等候神、靈修靜心操練，引導心靈進入像嬰孩安息於母親懷中的全然信靠。
verses.text_en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.text: 主耶穌說：「凡得勝的，我要賜他在我寶座上與我同坐，就如我勝了，在我父的寶座上與他同坐一樣。」
verses.application_note: 適用於敬拜讚美會，引導會眾以得勝者的屬靈眼光俯伏敬拜萬王之王。
verses.text_en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

verses.text: 主耶和華——以色列的聖者如此說：「你們得救在乎歸回安息；你們得力在乎平靜倚靠。」
verses.application_note: 陪伴身心俱疲者靈修，教導屬靈力量的源頭在於歸回神面前的平靜與信靠。
verses.text_en: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

categories.category_name: 6. 聖經的教義篇：信仰根基

topics.topic_name: 神論：上帝的屬性、權柄與創造

verses.text: 起初，神創造天地。
verses.application_note: 信仰基理與慕道班教學使用，奠定上帝是宇宙萬物唯一創造者與主權者的真理根基。
verses.text_en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

verses.text: 諸天述說神的榮耀；穹蒼傳揚祂的手段。
verses.application_note: 適用於自然啟示與讚美敬拜引言，引導會眾從受造世界認識神的榮耀與偉大。
verses.text_en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

verses.text: 以色列啊，你要聽！耶和華——我們神是獨一的主。
verses.application_note: 適用於基要真理課堂，確立獨一真神的神學核心（示瑪 Shema）。
verses.text_en: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

verses.text: 主耶和華啊，你曾用大能和伸出來的膀臂創造天地，在你沒有難成的事。
verses.application_note: 適用於堅固會眾信心，宣告創造天地之全能神的大能與全能屬性。
verses.text_en: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

verses.text: 深哉，神豐富的智慧和知識！祂的判斷何其難測！祂的蹤跡何其難尋！
verses.application_note: 神學默想與崇拜頌讚經文，引導會眾對神至高無上的智慧發出敬畏與讚歎。
verses.text_en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

topics.topic_name: 基督論：耶穌基督的降生、救贖與復活

verses.text: 神愛世人，甚至將祂的獨生子賜給他們，叫凡信祂的，不致滅亡，反得永生。
verses.application_note: 福音佈道、陪談決志的核心經文，清晰傳達神對人類的救贖計畫與愛。
verses.text_en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.text: 耶穌說：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裏去。」
verses.application_note: 適用於基要真理教學與福音問答，說明基督是連結神與人唯一的橋樑。
verses.text_en: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

verses.text: 因為神本性一切的豐盛都有形有體地居住在基督裏。
verses.application_note: 基督論教學，闡明耶穌基督完全的神性與豐盛。
verses.text_en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

verses.text: 祂本有神的形象，不以自己與神同等為強奪的；反倒虛己，取了奴僕的形象，成為人的樣式。
verses.application_note: 門徒造就與基督論教學，說明基督謙卑道成肉身與徹底捨己的榮耀生命。
verses.text_en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

verses.text: 除祂以外，別無拯救；因為在天下人間，沒有賜下別的名，我們可以靠著得救。
verses.application_note: 福音佈道與基要真理宣告，確立耶穌基督獨一無二的救贖權柄。
verses.text_en: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

topics.topic_name: 聖靈論：聖靈的位格、工作與恩賜

verses.text: 但聖靈降臨在你們身上，你們就必得著能力，並要在耶路撒冷、猶太全地，和撒瑪利亞，直到地極，作我的見證。
verses.application_note: 適用於宣教主日、事工訓練，強調聖靈保惠師賦予門徒生命大能與宣教使命。
verses.text_en: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

verses.text: 只等真理的聖靈來了，祂要引導你們明白一切的真理。
verses.application_note: 適用於研經與靈修講座，說明聖靈在信徒生命中擔任真理導師的角色。
verses.text_en: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

verses.text: 豈不知你們是神的殿，神的靈住在你們裏面嗎？
verses.application_note: 適用於聖潔生命造就，提醒信徒內住的聖靈使其身體成為神神聖的聖殿。
verses.text_en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

verses.text: 聖靈顯在各人身上，是叫人得益處。這一切都是這位聖靈所運行、隨己意分給各人的。
verses.application_note: 適用於恩賜探索課程與事工團隊配搭，說明屬靈恩賜源自聖靈的主權與服事目的。
verses.text_en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal. But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

verses.text: 你們既聽見真理的道，就是那叫你們得救的福音，也信了基督，既然信祂，就受了所應許的聖靈為印記。
verses.application_note: 適用於受洗班或救恩確據輔導，宣告聖靈是信徒得救不可抹滅的神聖印記。
verses.text_en: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

topics.topic_name: 救恩論：人的罪、悔改與因信稱義

verses.text: 因為世人都犯了罪，虧缺了神的榮耀；如今卻蒙神的恩典，因基督耶穌的救贖，就白白地稱義。
verses.application_note: 適用於慕道班課堂或認罪悔改訊息，闡明人的罪性以及蒙恩稱義的救恩真理。
verses.text_en: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God; Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

verses.text: 你們得救是本乎恩，也因著信；這並不是出於自己，乃是神所賜的；也不是出於行為，免得有人自誇。
verses.application_note: 基要真理培訓經文，強調得救完全出自神的白白恩典與人的信心接受，非靠行為積攢功德。
verses.text_en: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

verses.text: 因為罪的工價乃是死；惟有神的恩賜，在我們的主基督耶穌裏，乃是永生。
verses.application_note: 個人佈道（羅馬路）核心經文，對比罪的代價與基督永生的禮物。
verses.text_en: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.text: 你若口裏承認耶穌為主，心裏信神叫祂從死裏復活，就必得救。因為人心裏相信，就可以稱義；口裏承認，就可以得救。
verses.application_note: 決志禱告與慕道陪談經文，指明得救的具體步驟（心信與口認）。
verses.text_en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved. For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

verses.text: 我們既因信稱義，就藉著我們的主耶穌基督得與神相和。
verses.application_note: 救恩確據輔導經文，宣告因信稱義帶來的屬靈結果——恢復與神相和的關係。
verses.text_en: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

topics.topic_name: 聖經論：神的話語、啟示與權威

verses.text: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘，惟有我們神的話必永遠立定。
verses.application_note: 適用於研經班宣導或講道開場，確立聖經作為神的話語超越時間的最高權威與真實性。
verses.text_en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

verses.text: 第一要緊的，該知道經上所有的預言沒有可隨私意解說的；因為預言從來沒有出於人意的，乃是人被聖靈感動，說出神的話來。
verses.application_note: 聖經論課堂使用，解釋聖經的默示性與靈感性，避免私意解經。
verses.text_en: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation. For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

verses.text: 這聖經能使你因信基督耶穌，有得救的智慧。
verses.application_note: 適用於初信造就，說明研讀聖經能指引人認識救恩與得著屬天智慧。
verses.text_en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。
verses.application_note: 講道與靈修經文，宣告耶穌基督真理話語的永恆性與永不改變。
verses.text_en: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

verses.text: 人活著，不是單靠食物，乃是靠神口裏所出的一切話。
verses.application_note: 靈修養成運動經文，強調神的話語是心靈每日不可或缺的屬靈糧食。
verses.text_en: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

topics.topic_name: 教會論：基督的身體與門徒使命

verses.text: 你們就是基督的身子，並且各自作肢體。
verses.application_note: 適用於會友入會禮、肢體關係培訓，建立彼此連結、互相服事與各盡其職的教會觀。
verses.text_en: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

verses.text: 祂升天的時候，賜下使徒、先知、福音派、牧師和教師，為要成全聖徒，各盡其職，建立基督的身體。
verses.application_note: 同工團隊培訓，強調教會運作目標在於裝備聖徒、發揮恩賜以建立教會。
verses.text_en: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

verses.text: 主耶穌說：「這家就是永生神的教會，真理的柱石和根基。」
verses.application_note: 教會觀專題，說明教會在世代中守護並宣揚真理的重要職責。
verses.text_en: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

verses.text: 惟有你們是被揀選的族類，是有君尊的祭司，是聖潔的國度，是屬神的子民，要叫你們宣揚那召你們出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
verses.application_note: 適用於信徒身份認同與宣教使命培訓，宣告全體信徒皆為屬神祭司的神聖使命。
verses.text_en: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

verses.text: 這天國的福音要傳遍天下，對萬民作見證，然後末期才來到。
verses.application_note: 宣教主日與大使命挑戰，激勵教會積極參與普世宣教。
verses.text_en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

topics.topic_name: 末世論：基督再臨、永生與最後審判

verses.text: 神要擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛，因為以前的事都過去了。
verses.application_note: 適用於追思探訪、面對苦難或末世講道，給予會眾對新天新地與永恆無比榮耀的盼望。
verses.text_en: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

verses.text: 加利利人哪，你們為什麼站著望天呢？這離開你們被接升天的耶穌，你們見祂怎樣往天上去，祂還要怎樣來。
verses.application_note: 末世論教學，宣告基督必將親自、榮耀地第二次降臨。
verses.text_en: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

verses.text: 但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟獨父知道。所以，你們要儆醒。
verses.application_note: 末世警戒經文，提醒信徒防範異端防邪教，並在日常生活中保持屬靈警惕。
verses.text_en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only. Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

verses.text: 因為我們眾人必要在基督台前顯露出來，叫各人按著本身所行的，或善或惡受報。
verses.application_note: 管家忠心警惕經文，提醒信徒珍惜光陰與恩賜，準備好面對基督台前的審判與獎賞。
verses.text_en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

verses.text: 證明這事的說：「是的，我必快來！」阿們！主耶穌啊，我願你來！
verses.application_note: 全書結尾與末世盼望禱告，引導信徒帶著渴慕的心期待基督再臨（瑪拉拿達 Maranatha）。
verses.text_en: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
